section.8: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

8.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

hadiths.text: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone says "I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion and with Muhammad (ﷺ) as Apostle" Paradise will be his due
